divergence: Mixed (T0, T2 pass; T1 fails). All runs found the same lead candidates through a store-wide scan. T1 and T2 both read a later matter's diligence memo and first wrote that matter as the headline; in both, the write-stage review questioned headlining it over the dedicated matter. The split is at the check stage after writing: T2 revised the headline and passed, T1 only re-read the file and kept it, although the critic's flag was the same. T0 listed the later matter but judged its mentions incidental and wrote the dedicated matter from the start.
